mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES mobility from -53.1% to -28.0% over the last two weeks indicates a gradual return to office-based work, which will drive increased demand for retail and recreation services during weekdays over the next four weeks.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days following a week-on-week drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility exceeding 2 points.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days, despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES showing recent upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility from 3.6% to -6.0% over the last four weeks, when coupled with easing restrictions, indicates a shift from essential-only outings towards discretionary spending, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days, even if GROCERY_PHARM continues its downward trend and restrictions are confirmed to be easing.

mechanism_narrative: High volatility in PARKS mobility, especially when it drops significantly (e.g., from 11.4% to -15.0%), suggests that people are seeking indoor or less weather-dependent activities, which could divert some recreational spending towards retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 7 days following a week-on-week drop in PARKS mobility exceeding 5 points.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not show an upward trend over the next 14 days, despite RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated and GROCERY_PHARM continuing to decline.

mechanism_narrative: The persistently deep negative TRANSIT mobility (e.g., below -50%), if maintained or worsened due to ongoing or tightening restrictions, will continue to suppress overall movement, directly limiting access and desire for retail and recreation, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -50% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days, despite TRANSIT mobility remaining below -50% for two consecutive weeks under tightening restrictions.
